pressure_note: not stated (isopiestic equilibrium in vacuum-type isopiestic system at 50 C; no pressure given)

value.what: molality of CaCl2 test solution in isopiestic equilibrium with NaCl

value2.what: molality of NaCl reference solution at the same water activity

composition.other_species: LiCl (column m_LiCl) is a second test salt equilibrated simultaneously with the same NaCl reference solution; outside the in-scope salt set; the NaCl and LiCl solutions are separate isopiestic cups, not part of the CaCl2 solution

notes: The printed table has two side-by-side blocks of 10 rows each (left block rows 0-9, right block rows 10-19); stacked left block first. Each row is the molality of each salt in isopiestic equilibrium (equal water activity) at 50 C; each is the average of two or three replicate samples per salt. The paper does not state per-kg-water explicitly beyond 'molality'. Authors' osmotic coefficients (Table II, smoothed) are not in this table.
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: each row is three separate solutions (NaCl reference, LiCl, CaCl2) equilibrated through the vapour phase at equal water activity, not a mixture; composition.per_row therefore lists the CaCl2 test solution only, the NaCl reference molality is value2.
